verses.text: Ayik mantalaj jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik, aytaxon ek' jun Slolonel Dios sb'i. Ha jun chi' aytaxon ek' yet' Dios, Dios ton wal.
Ayik manto sb'o jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik Dios, aytaxon ek' yet'ok.
A' yak'lab'ejnak Dios chi' ayik sb'oannak masanil tastak. Malaj junok tas b'onak tato manh yujok.
Ha Slolonel Dios chi', aj k 'inal. Yuj jun k 'inal chi' ay sakil k'inal t'ayonh anima onh tik.
Ha jun sakil k'inal chi' tz'ak'an sakil k'inal b'aj ay k'ik' k'inal. Haxo jun k'ik' k'inal chi', max yal-laj yak'an tup jun sakil k'inal chi'.
Ay jun winh chekb'ilkot yuj Dios skuchan Juan.
Ulnakek' winh yak' testigoal sb'a yuj jun sakil k'inal chi', yik wach' masanil mach tz'ak'anoch jun sakil k'inal chi' t'a sk'ool.
Manhoklaj winhaj Juan chi' aj sakil k'inal, tonhej ul yak'nak testigoal sb'a winh yuj.
Ha jun yel sakil k'inal chi', wan sjawi t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. A' tz'ak'an sakil k'inal t'a masanil heb' anima.
Ha jun Slolonel Dios sb'i chi', ulnakek' t'a tik. Ha b'ojinak yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Palta ayik ix uleq'ui, maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' anima tato ha'.
Ha t'a juntzanh heb' yiko', hata' ulnak eq'ui, palta maj chajoklaj yuj heb' yik chi'.
Palta a jantaknhej heb' schaani, jantaknhej heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a sk'ool, a tz'alani to ay yalan yik heb' yoch yuninalok Dios.

Ayik tz'och heb' yuninalok Dios, ichato tz'aljixi heb'. Palta manh lajanok icha tz'aj yalji heb' anima. Manh animaok ay snib'ej tz'alji heb'. Manh yujok snib'ej junok winak, palta ha Dios tz'ak'anoch heb' yuninalok.

Ha jun Slolonel Dios sb'i chi', ochnak sniwanil icha kiko'. Ulnakek' kajan t'a ko kal. Ha jun chi' te yel. Niwan swach'k'olal Dios ul sch'oxnak t'ayonh. Kilnak wal sniwanil yelk'ochi, yujto anhej wal jun chi' Yuninal Dios, kotnak t'a Smam.

Ha winhaj Juan aljinakkan yab'ixal jun chi' icha tik: --Ay jun tzak'an sja wuuj, palta ek'alto wal yelk'och yopisio t'a wichanh, yujto ayik manto in alji, aytaxon eq'ui. Walnakxo yab'ixal t'ayex, xchi winh.
Ha jun chi', tz'akan yaj swach'k'olal, yuj chi' tz'akan sch'ox swach'k'olal chi' t'ayonh.
Ha winhaj Moisés ak'jinakkan sley Dios t'ayonh. Haxo Jesucristo sch'oxan swach'k'olal Dios t'ayonh, syak'an jun sk'ayb'ub'al te yel.
Malaj junok mach ix ilan Dios junelok. Palta a jun pitanh Yuninal, Dios ton paxi, a ul ch'oxjinakeli. Ha jun Yuninal tik junnhejtaxon yaj yet' Smam chi'.

Ha junel, ay juntzanh heb' israel aj Jerusalén, ix schekb'at jaywanh heb' sakerdote heb' yet' jaywanh heb' yinhtilal Leví. Ha t'a winhaj Juan ix k'och heb'. Ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a winh: --¿Mach ach? xchi heb'.
Ix yalan sjichanil winhaj Juan chi' t'a heb': --Ha in tik, manhok in Cristo in, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ix sk'anb'an pax heb' t'a winh: --¿Mach ach jun? ¿Mato a ach Elías ach? xchi heb'. --Manhok in laj, xchi winh. --¿Mato a ach tik schekab' ach Dios tanhwab'il kuuj? xchi heb'. --Maay, xchi winh.
Ix sk'anb'anxi heb' t'a winh: --¿Mach ach pax jun? Al t'ayonh mach ach, yujto yowalil ol b'at kalxi yab' heb' onh chekankoti. Al t'ayonh tas aji, xchi heb'.

Yuj chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ha in tik tzin awaj t'a tzinan lu'um, swalan icha tik: Icha tz'aj sb'o b'e ayik sjawi junok yajal, icha chi' tzeyutej he b'oan he b'eyb'al, yujto ol ja winh Kajal, xin chi. Yujto icha chi' yajkan stz'ib'aj wab'ixal yuj winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios t'a peka', xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ha juntzanh heb' xit'nak ek' t'a winhaj Juan chi', haton heb' winh fariseo chekannakb'at heb'.
Ix sk'anb'an pax heb' t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj tzak' bautizar heb' anima tato manh ach Cristooc, tato manh ach Elíasoc, tato manhok ach schekab' Dios tanhwab'il kuuj? xchi heb' t'a winh.
--Ha in tik swak' bautizar heb' anima t'a ha ha'. Palta ay jun ayxoek' t'a ko kal tik manto eyojtakok.
Ha jun chi', tzak'an sja wuuj, ek'al yopisio t'a wichanh. Manh in mojok wak'an serwil, wach'chom tonhej tzin tijel sch'anhal xanhab' t'a yok, xchi winhaj Juan chi' t'a heb'.
Ha t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán, t'a jun lugar skuch Betania, hata' ix ak'ji bautizar heb' anima yuj winhaj Juan chi'. Hata' pax ix b'at sk'anb'ej juntzanh tik heb' t'a winh.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix yilanb'at winhaj Juan to wan sk'och Jesús, ix yalan winh: --Inai, a yopisio jun wan sja tik, icha yopisio nok' kalnel, icha chi' yaj yopisio yuj Dios, yujto ha' ix jawi yik'kanel ko mul ko masanil t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Haton jun tik walnak: Ay jun tzak'an sja wuuj, palta ek'al yopisio t'ayin, yujto ayik manto in alji, aytaxon eq'ui, xin chi.
Max nachajel wuuj mach jun chi', palta in ja wak' bautizar heb' anima t'a ha ha', yik wach' ol nachajel yuj heb' ketisraelal mach jun chi', xchi winhaj Juan chi'.
Ix yalanpax winh: --Ix wil yemul Yespíritu Dios t'a satcha'anh t'a yib'anh icha junok nok' paramuch, ix em t'a yib'anh, ix ochkan t'ay.

Max nachajel wuuj, mach jun chi'. Palta a jun chekjinak in kot wak' bautizar heb' anima t'a ha ha', ha' ix halan t'ayin: Ol il yemul Wespíritu t'a yib'anh junok mach, ol ochkan t'ay. Ha jun chi' ol ak'anoch Espíritu Santo t'a heb' anima, ichato ol ak'jok bautizar heb' yuj, xchi Dios t'ayin.
Ha in tik ix wil jun chi'. Yuj chi' swak' testigoal in b'a yuj to a Jesús tik, Yuninal ton Dios, xchi winh.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ayek' winhaj Juan yet' chawanh heb' winh sk'ayb'um.
Haxo ix yilanb'at winh, wan yek' Jesús ta'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh: --Inai, a jun tzek' chi', icha yopisio junok nok' kalnel, icha chi' yopisio yuj Dios, xchi winh.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb' winh sk'ayb'um winhaj Juan chi', ix och tzak'an heb' winh yuj Jesús.
Haxo ix meltzajb'at k'elan Jesús chi' t'a spatik. Ix yilani, tzak'anoch heb' winh yuj. --¿Tas tze saya'? xchi t'a heb' winh. --Ach ko k'ayb'umal ¿b'ajtil ay a posado? xchi heb' winh t'ay.

--Kotanhek, b'at kileknab'i b'aj ay in posado chi', xchi t'a heb' winh. Ix b'at heb' winh yet'ok, ix b'at yilan heb' winh b'aj ayeq'ui. Wanxo yem k'u ix b'at heb' winh, yuj chi' k'ik'b'alxo ix jax heb' winh.
Ix yab' chawanh heb' winh chi' tas ix yal winhaj Juan chi', yuj chi' ix och tzak'an heb' winh yuj Jesús. Ay jun winh skuch Andrés, yuk'tak sb'a winh yet' winhaj Simón Pedro.

Ixlajwi slolon winhaj Andrés chi' yet' Jesús chi', ix b'at sayan winh yuk'tak winh chi'. Haxo ix chax winh yuj winh, ix yalan winh: --Ix ilchaj winh Mesías kuuj, xchi winh. (Mesías syalelk'ochi, Cristo, Ak'b'il Yopisio).

Junanto rato chi', ix yik'anb'at winh yuk'tak winh chi' t'a Jesús. Ix och k'elan Jesús t'a winhaj Simón, ix yalan t'a winh: --Simón, yuninal ach winhaj Juan. Kefas ol a b'iejkani, xchi t'a winh. (Kefas syalelk'ochi, Pedro, ma a k'een k'een.)
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix snaan Jesús sb'at t'a yol yik Galilea. Ix ilchaj winhaj Felipe yuj. --Ochanh in k'ayb'umok, xchi t'a winh.
Ha winhaj Felipe chi', aj chonhab' Betsaida winh, haton schonhab' winhaj Andrés yet' winhaj Pedro.

Haxo winhaj Felipe chi' xit' sayankot winhaj Natanael. Haxo ix ilchaj winh yuj winh, ix yalan winh: --Ay jun ix ilchaj kuuj. Haton jun chi' tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal yuj winhaj Moisés t'a ley, tz'ib'ab'ilpaxkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka', haton Jesús, yuninal winhaj José aj chonhab' Nazaret, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Natanael chi': --¿Tom ay junok tas wach' syal skot t'a Nazaret chi'? xchi winh. --Kotanh, b'at kilnab'i, xchi winhaj Felipe chi'.
Haxo ix yilan Jesús to wan sk'och winhaj Natanael chi', ix yalani: --Ha jun winh sjawi tik, yel ton wal israel winh t'a yichanh Dios, malaj b'aj chab' sat syutej sb'a winh, xchi Jesús.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winhaj Natanael chi' t'ay: --¿Tas ix utej in ojtakaneli? xchi winh. --Ayik manto ach yawtejkot winhaj Felipe tik, toxo ix ach wila''. Ayach ek' t'a yich jun te' higo, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
--Ach in k'ayb'umal, yel Yuninal ach Dios. Ko Reyal ach a onh israel onh tik, xchi winh t'ay.
--¿Yujnhejto ix wala': Ix ach wil t'a yich jun te' higo, yuj chi' tzin ak'och t'a a k'ool? Palta ayto juntzanhxo ch'oxnab'il satub'tak ol ila', te niwan yelk'ochi, xchi t'a winh.

Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb' ayek' chi' yet'ok: --Wal yel swal t'ayex, ol eyila' to jakan spuertail satcha'anh. Haxo heb' yángel Dios ol eyil sk'e heb' yet' yemxul heb' t'ayin a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, xchi Jesús.
